status: HYPOTHETICAL/SYNTHETIC ONLY — NOT observed household results
purpose: Show transparent arithmetic and how to reproduce weather-adjusted, sequenced synthetic interventions.

setpoint_sensitivity.interpretation: Steady-state illustrative savings per one assumed day, not an observed change, a 30-day winter simulation or an annual price quote.

electric_car_sensitivity.interpretation: 52 repeated weekly mileage assumptions, no public charging bill, capital/maintenance, PV or battery allocation.

solar_sensitivity.interpretation: Assumed self-consumption fraction and generation, not derived from a measured roof or interval-level solar and battery power balance.

longitudinal_outputs: results.json, three labelled synthetic daily CSV samples, and an EV-then-solar timeline; code regenerates them locally and accounts for weather in a pre-only regression.
scientific_limit: Synthetic recoverability tests cannot establish real causal effects, detector accuracy, setpoint identification, insulation quality or tariff suitability.
